usgs2013Product.labelRevision: 2017-05-01 David P. Mayer (USGS), initial PDS3 label pointing to GeoTIFF; not acquisition.
usgs2013Product.heightSemantics: Publisher describes values as radii in metres. This supports reviewing current scale1/offset-255000 conversion as a radius-to-reference-height operation, but exact source pixel reproduction is not tested in this batch.
usgs2013Product.processingClaims: Publisher says 5439 stereo clear-filter images, approximately 95 percent surface coverage, about 35000 multi-stereo combinations and 83000 control points; mean intersection error +/-8 m. These are publisher processing claims, not independently reproduced physical accuracy.
usgs2013Product.epochCaution: Publisher narrative gives six cycles late September–early November2011 and21cycles December2011–April2012, approximately2500 clear-filter images, while DTM paragraph gives5439. Content range2011-12-01 to2012-04-30 is not every input/pixel acquisition date. Counts and chronology retained without reconciliation.
usgs2013Product.frameCaution: Publisher reports preliminary150degrees east shift, Claudia146E/ClaudiaDoublePrime, DLR2013-11-22 reference, and warns required SPICE was unavailable for processing in ISIS3. No extra shift or new SPICE/frame adoption.
usgs2013Product.accuracy: Best Effort; horizontal Unknown; vertical Accurate to Control Net. Intersection precision is not independently verified absolute accuracy.
usgs2013Product.isis3Encoding: Publisher ISIS3 label: Real, Lsb, Base0, Multiplier1, Core StartByte69786; no archive DN-times2 transfer. Labels are metadata, not a full TIFF inspection.

pds2016DistinctArchive.declaredCoverage: 2011-09-29 to2012-07-24; HAMO1 September29–November1,2011 and HAMO2 June15–July24,2012; not dates assigned to all pixels.
pds2016DistinctArchive.grid: Archive overview64pixels/degree (~70m), cylindrical centre30degreesClaudiaDoublePrime, longitude -150 to+210; separate north/south stereographic products. Not the2013USGS48ppd centre0 product.
pds2016DistinctArchive.encoding: PDS overview says archive DN times2 gives height metres; planetary radius adds255000m. This encoding is not transferred to the separate32bit USGS radius TIFF or existing16bit derivative.
pds2016DistinctArchive.accuracyCoverageClaims: Overview ~95percent, polar shadow interpolation, forward-ray intersection +/-6m; refined control point accuracy +/-8m. Publisher claims not independently reproduced, not exact all-pixel confidence or physical accuracy.
pds2016DistinctArchive.pole: Overview refined RA309.0319+/-0.005deg, DEC42.2228+/-0.005deg versus IAU2013RA309.031+/-0.03,DEC42.235+/-0.03; W0 285.39,W1 1617.3329428deg/day unchanged. Recommended dawn_vesta_SPG20160901.tpc is an archive-version reference, not loaded or applied.
pds2016DistinctArchive.ellipsoid: Archive best-fit ellipsoid(285.2,277.7,223.8km), long axis40.6E, is model information; no shape/catalogue adoption or new axis/radius calculation.
pds2016DistinctArchive.limits: No PDS IMG, archive label, coordinate document, geometry kernel or full DTM downloaded. Dataset overview is not direct pixel identity, cache ancestry or registration proof.
